html:
Peace to All, Brothers and Sisters, It seems right to us, in these days that make us reflect on the value of Peace, to remember how the Universal Zulu Nation Stands for Peace , and as the UZN logo above says, for One Culture, One Art, One Energy .

§

A Unique Energy, Universal = Universal, meaning for Everyone.
The Universal Zulu Nation stands for Peace, for anyone who wants Peace in the world, and it is not just a question of not wanting War, for Universal Zulu Nation Peace is "a Universal principle" and should be an inviolable Universal Right of man, as well as one of the main objectives to be achieved by UZN , in any context and in any place.

That's why it's been said from the very beginning that Universal Zulu Nation Stands for "Peace, Unity, Love and Having Fun" , which in Italian means that the Universal Zulu Nation stands for "Peace, Unity, Love and Having Fun".

We all know that an organization that has this motto can only stand for World Peace, a "Universal Peace" , a Universal Peace , which embraces all Cultures and Peoples through Respect, Knowledge and Equality.
Hip Hop and the Zulu Nation were born from a context of deep racial hatred exacerbated by poverty and ignorance, where people killed each other, just because they were from different neighborhoods and races.

For this reason, after the "Gang Peace Treaty" was resolved , Hip Hop was able to be born and grow with its mottos and ideals of Peace, Love, Union, and Fun. The main goal was to bring Peace and Sharing among the various races, and thus create a Universal Culture, which would be enriched by the best of each individual culture brought within it, without losing its identity, but strengthening it at the same time. This would allow for recognition and improvement for all. The concept of sharing for global improvement is another of the fundamental concepts of Universal Zulu Nation. For this reason, Universal Zulu Nation comes in Peace.

Peace Ahki, Peace Malika, Peace Brother, Peace King/Queen , this is how a member of Universal Zulu Nation should address his Brothers and Sisters. In reality, since we are all Brothers and Sisters (Universal People, One Energy), ultimately he should do so with everyone. This is for various reasons, from the most practical to the most spiritual.
One of the most practical reasons, in those times, was to demonstrate one's intentions of Peace to the other : I am coming in Peace, I have no bellicose intentions, in essence.
Another, more spiritual reason, is to recognize the divinity and the common Soul of the other and declare it as a sign of recognition and respect for the most spiritual part of one's Brothers and Sisters . Brothers and Sisters because in the Zulu and Hip Hop conception, there is only one family, the Human family, a "Universal Family."
Another reason, somewhere between the practical and the spiritual, is that the word Peace has a very specific frequency, which immediately elevates the encounter with others. Nowadays, there are many examples of how water is influenced by the use of different information, so it is no longer just a formal aspect, but also physical. Greeting with Peace is a good wish for everyone without distinction.
Furthermore, obviously, at the time it served to reduce tension between the various racial groups.
Here we see some of the characteristics that lead to peace taken from the rules and regulations of the Universal Zulu Nation.
  • The Universal Zulu Nation is an organization of individuals seeking success, peace, knowledge, wisdom, and the right way of life.
  • Zulu members must seek ways to survive positively in this society.
  • Negative actions are those of the unjust. Animal nature is negative. The Zulus must be civilized.
  • Zulus must be at peace with themselves and with others, always.
  • Zulus should greet each other with the appropriate greeting, such as Peace Ahki, or Peace Queen.
  • Zulus should remember to lead a peaceful life and try to be just.
  • The Zulus must seek Self-knowledge to rise out of this jungle.
We here introduce another fundamental concept of the Universal Zulu Nation: that through personal and individual improvement, we can help our community and the entire world achieve a higher consciousness, a superior harmony, and the long-awaited peace among all peoples and cultures of the world. This concept is increasingly supported by the concept of Collective Consciousness, which we recommend you explore further. Let's not forget that...
The Universal Zulu Nation is about to
Knowledge, Wisdom, Understanding, Freedom, Justice, Equality, Peace, Unity, Love, Respect, Work, Fun, Overcoming the Negative with the Positive, Economics, Mathematics, Science, Life, Truth, Facts, Faith in One (Universal) God.
Finally, we leave you with an example of the Hip Hop and Zulu mentality, put to music by two Sacred Monsters: "James Brown", the godfather of Funk , and "Afrika Bambaataa" , the father of Hip Hop Culture and founder of the "Universal Zulu Nation".
With "Nuclear Wild Style - James Brown & Afrika Bambaataa"

We would add that anyone wishing to provide concrete assistance to those affected by war (wars) can easily find organizations that deal with this, perhaps by relying on people they know personally, so as to be sure that their humanitarian aid efforts are used correctly.
Peace! Universal Zulu Nation Italy.
